items.question: * M Did you order new business cards?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“* M Did you order new business cards?”，自然应答是“Yes, I included the company logo this time.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（Yes, I included the company logo this time.）。
